LanguageData.ESCP_Alert_Notoriety_Desc: Word has spread about what this colony has been doing to people. Bounty hunters may come looking for a payday.
LanguageData.ESCP_Enemy_Of_Enlist_Faction_Desc: By enlisting with {ENLISTED_name}, you have become an enemy of {HOSTILE_name}. They are now hostile toward your colony.
LanguageData.ESCP_Enlist_NoMissions: No missions on file right now.
LanguageData.ESCP_Enlist_OpenTerminalDesc: Open the {0} ledger to manage missions, salary, supplies, and standing.
LanguageData.ESCP_NoDeliveryQuestsAvailable: No delivery contracts available at this outpost right now.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Demoted_Expedition: {0} was reduced from {1} to {2} after a failed errand.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Demoted_KickedOut: {0} was reduced from {1} to {2} after the order turned its back on the colony.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_DismissGizmoDesc: Dismiss {0} from formation, letting them return to what they were doing.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_DrillGizmoDesc: Drill with any colonist. Both stop and draw their weapons for the session. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Expedition_DepartureInterrupte: {0}'s departure was interrupted before they could leave.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Expedition_FailText: {0}'s {1} went badly and cost them their rank.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Expedition_GearLost: {0} lost their {1} out in the field.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Expedition_Injured: {0} came back from their mission injured.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Expedition_NoExit: {0} can't find a way off the map to depart on the expedition.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_FormUpGizmoDesc: Order {0} to form up behind you in ranks, up to four deep, interrupting whatever they're doing. They'll hold formation until dismissed.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_History_MentorDown: Mentor {0} went down in battle. Surged with a squire's duty.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_InspectGizmoDesc: Inspect a lower-ranked colonist's weapon and armor condition. They'll draw their weapon for the review. Well-kept gear earns a commendation, neglected gear earns a reprimand. Once per day per colonist.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_InspectionComplete_Commended: {0} commends {1} for keeping their gear in top condition.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_InspectionComplete_NoGear: {0} looks {1} over, but there's no weapon or armor to inspect.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_InspectionComplete_Passed: {0} looks {1} over. Nothing to report either way.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_InspectionComplete_Reprimanded: {0} reprimands {1} for the poor state of their gear.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Lineage_Empty: No notable figures are known yet. Assign a mentor to start a line of teaching.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_MentorDown_Message: {0}'s mentor, {1}, has fallen! {0} surges with a squire's duty.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_NoPawnSelected: Choose a colonist to see their standing.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_NotEnrolled: Holds no rank in any guild or order.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_PunishGizmoDesc: Sentence a lower-ranked colonist to a stretch of hard labor, souring their mood. Once per day per colonist.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_RallyGizmoDesc: Rally every member of {0} on this map with a burst of speed and morale. Once every few days.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Rally_Text: {0} raises a call to arms, and every member of {1} on the map feels its pull.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Records_Empty: Nothing has been written in the chronicle yet.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_StudyGizmoDesc: Study with another scholarly-ranked colonist. Both gain skill XP. Once per day.
LanguageData.ESCP_Rank_Suspended_Text: No longer enlisted with the faction that grants this rank. Standing benefits are suspended until you re-enlist with {0}. Progress is not lost.
LanguageData.ESCP_TrainingNotEnoughFunds: Not enough coin to pay for training.
LanguageData.ESCP_Settings_Enlistment_Intro: Your colonists can sign on with these guilds and factions by sending a caravan to one of their settlements. Members can draw pay, pick up provisions, keep goods in storage, take paid work or training, and accept jobs from the mission board. Hover over an entry to see what it offers. Untick one to stop it being offered. Anyone already enlisted keeps their place but can't use it until it's ticked again.
LanguageData.ESCP_Settings_Enlistment_Guilds_Desc: Joined at a guild hall in any town that hosts one.
LanguageData.ESCP_Settings_Enlistment_Factions_Desc: Joined at the faction's own settlements, once they think well enough of you. Sworn enemies of everyone, like the Falmer hives and the Volkihar, never take recruits and aren't listed.
LanguageData.ESCP_Enchantment_NoWeapon: no weapon that can be enchanted
LanguageData.ESCP_Expedition_Return_Errand: {PAWN_labelShort} has returned from a guild errand, tired and a little richer.
LanguageData.ESCP_Expedition_Return_FactionErrand: {PAWN_labelShort} is back from their errand with dust on their boots and a few coins in their purse.
LanguageData.ESCP_Expedition_Return_FactionCampaign: {PAWN_labelShort} has come home from a long campaign, thinner and quieter than when they left.
LanguageData.ESCP_Expedition_Return_Contract: {PAWN_labelShort} has returned from a long contract with stories they are not allowed to tell.
